{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the full population size
full_population_size = len(data)
print(f'full_population_size: {full_population_size}')

# Count sentinel values
sentinel_count = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'sentinel_count: {sentinel_count}')

# Filter out sentinel values
valid_data = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]
valid_count = len(valid_data)
print(f'valid_count: {valid_count}')

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age_valid = valid_data['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'mean_age_valid: {mean_age_valid}')

# Compute mean age including -1 (for comparison only)
mean_age_all = data['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'mean_age_all: {mean_age_all}')"}
